name: Sanur Bali International Half Marathon 2027
short_description: The Sanur Bali International Half Marathon returns on Sunday 7 February 2027 on the beachfront at Sanur, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: The Sanur Bali International Half Marathon 2027 (SIHM) takes place on Sunday 7 February 2027 on the beachfront at Sanur, Denpasar, and bills itself as Bali's first half marathon with a beach setting. It is organised by RajaLARI with Prama Sanur Beach Bali, and offers 5 km, 10 km and a 21 km half marathon, with entry from Rp 490,000. The 2026 edition on 8 February drew around 4,500 runners from 34 countries on a course around Pantai Mertasari.

faqs.question: When is the Sanur Bali International Half Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 7 February 2027, on the beachfront at Sanur in Denpasar, Bali. The event is held each February; the 2026 edition was on 8 February and drew around 4,500 runners from 34 countries.

faqs.question: What distances does the Sanur Bali International Half Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: Three: 5 km, 10 km and a 21 km half marathon, with entry from Rp 490,000. There is no full marathon at this event, and the half marathon is the headline distance that gives the race its name.
